title: The Resolution of the Identity as a Generator of Exact Integral Identities: A Coherent-State Approach
summary: The resolution of the identity is typically utilized as a passive representation tool in standard quantum mechanics textbooks. In this paper, we reinterpret this traditional perspective by introducing the resolution of the identity associated with Glauber coherent states as a direct generator of exact complex Gaussian integral identities.
